Jalapeno Margaritas
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 2:09pm

Ingredients




4 Jalapeno peppers, halved lengthways
16 ounces (fl) tequila
1 ounce (fl) Triple Sec liqueur
3 ounces (fl) bottled/fresh lime juice
Coarse salt to garnish (optional)

Preparation

1 Put the peppers into the bottle of tequila and allow to steep for at least three days. For 4 margaritas, pour 150ml (0.25 pint) of jalapeno tequila, 30ml (1 fl oz) of Triple Sec and 90ml (3 fl oz) of lime juice into a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Stir and strain into glasses over fresh ice cubes. 2 If desired, first dip the rims of the glasses into lime juice and then into salt.
